pages.speaker: npc
lines: Hello there! My name is Oak. People call me the Pokémon Professor!

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Recently, there have been sightings of many rare Pokémon species.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: I'm talking about Pokémon that have never been seen in Kanto.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: I have a request for you. Here, take these.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: It is my invention, the Pokédex!

pages.speaker: npc
lines: It automatically records data on Pokémon you've seen or caught. It's a high-tech encyclopedia!

pages.speaker: npc
lines: You can't get detailed data on Pokémon by just seeing them.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: You must catch them to obtain complete data.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: So, here are some Poké Balls for catching wild Pokémon.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: When a wild Pokémon appears, throw a Poké Ball at it and try to catch it!

pages.speaker: npc
lines: This won't always work, however. A healthy Pokémon can escape. You have to be lucky!

pages.speaker: npc
lines: To make a complete guide on all the Pokémon in the world...

pages.speaker: npc
lines: But, I'm too old. I can't get the job done.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: So, I want you to fulfill my dream for me.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Get moving! And come see me sometime.

pages.speaker: npc
lines: After all, I want to know how your Pokédex is coming along.
